faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.a1: No. They are original questions created for practice, inspired by the general format of the public TCF. Only France Education international and an accredited centre can award the official TCF.
faq.q2: How is the CEFR level computed?
faq.a2: Using a configurable scale defined in the application code. It is a pedagogical approximation for practice, not the official TCF scale.
faq.q3: What happens if I lose my connection?
faq.a3: Your answers are already stored server-side. Saving resumes as soon as the connection is back. The timer, however, stays authoritative on the server.
faq.q4: Can I pause a test and resume later?
faq.a4: Yes. The timer is unique and covers the two written modules. If you close the page you will find the in-progress attempt with the exact remaining time, as long as the 60 minutes have not elapsed.
faq.q5: How long does a test take?
faq.a5: A written test takes 60 minutes in total: language structure (20 questions) and reading comprehension (30 questions). The oral comprehension series are worked through question by question (15 questions each), with a single listen per audio.
faq.a6: Yes, an account is needed to keep your results, history and progress curve. You can also sign in with Google.

guide.title: Everything about the TCF Tout public
guide.subtitle: The TCF Tout public is designed and run by France Education international. It assesses your level of French for study, professional or personal projects. This guide covers the tests, the duration, how to prepare and which resources to rely on.

epreuves.title: The three tests of the TCF Tout public
epreuves.lead: The exam is made up of three compulsory parts. Each one assesses a distinct skill, and all three weigh in on the final level.
epreuves.oralBody: You listen to several audio documents, then answer the related questions.
epreuves.oralTip: Practise understanding a document after a single listening. On the day there is no second chance: concentration must be total from the first seconds.
epreuves.structureBody: This part tests your knowledge of French grammar, vocabulary and language structures. You choose the correct answer from several options.
epreuves.structureTip: Review grammar points regularly and build up your vocabulary. This is the part most sensitive to method: consistency beats talent.
epreuves.ecritBody: You read several documents, then answer the related questions. Texts cover everyday, professional or academic situations.
epreuves.ecritTip: Do not try to understand every word. Learn to spot the important information and the keywords quickly: that is what makes the difference at this level.
epreuves.noteBody: Both written parts are reproduced identically in our mock exams: language structures (20 questions) and reading comprehension (30 questions), corrected question by question. Listening is covered by 8 practice series from A1 to C2 (15 questions each), with transcriptions and explanations.

duree.title: How long does the TCF take?
duree.lead: The duration depends on the format used to sit the exam.
duree.paperHint: Invigilated candidates at an accredited centre
duree.noteBody: The official TCF contains more questions than the simulations offered on some practice websites. Always check the official information from your test centre: it is authoritative.

preparation.title: How to prepare for the TCF properly
preparation.lead: You do not need to sit nothing but mock exams. Effective preparation combines three levels: learning, targeted practice and full-length simulation.
preparation.learnBody: Work regularly on grammar, vocabulary, listening comprehension, reading comprehension and the different types of TCF questions.
preparation.trainBody: Do exercises regularly and analyse your mistakes. Do not stop at looking at your score.
preparation.mockBody: Once you have done enough work, run full simulations with a timer. This gets you used to time pressure and to the question format.

methode.title: The study method that actually improves results
methode.lead: On a mistake, do not stop at the verdict. Two questions are enough to turn a failure into progress.
methode.q1Body: Read the prompt again, look at every option and identify what tipped your choice.
methode.q2Title: Which rule or piece of information did I get wrong?
methode.q2Body: That is the point to work on. Write it down, then check that the next test has fixed it.
methode.flowNote: The more you analyse your mistakes, the more effective your preparation becomes. It is the only indicator that truly counts.

ressources.title: Reference resources
ressources.lead: Three resources complement our mock exams well. The first two are official.
ressources.tvBody: Free practice for listening, reading and language structures, developed with the TCF teams at France Education international.
ressources.feiBody: The official TCF website: test overview, candidate manual, sample papers and registration information for accredited centres.
ressources.rfiBody: Audio resources to work on listening comprehension, get used to different accents and to varied communication situations.

conseils.title: Our advice for TCF day
conseils.oralItems1: Stay focused from the very beginning.
conseils.oralItems2: Get used to understanding documents after a single listening.
conseils.oralItems3: Try to identify quickly who is speaking, to whom, where and why.
conseils.oralItems4: Do not get stuck on a question.
conseils.structureItems1: Work regularly on grammar and vocabulary.
conseils.structureItems2: If you hesitate too long, move on to the next question.
conseils.structureItems3: Watch agreements, verb tenses, prepositions and vocabulary.
conseils.ecritItems1: Read the question and the options first, when that helps.
conseils.ecritItems2: Look for the keywords in the document.
conseils.ecritItems3: Do not spend too long on a single question.
conseils.ecritItems4: Practise spotting the information you are looking for quickly.
conseils.tempsBody: Time matters in the TCF. Practise regularly with a timer to build your pace and to know when to come back to a question.

avertissement.title: What to know before signing up
avertissement.warningTitle: Simulators do not replace the official exam
avertissement.warningBody: Mock exams and simulators are preparation tools. They do not replace the official TCF and do not issue any official certificate. To obtain a TCF certificate you must sit the exam at an accredited centre.
avertissement.objectiveBody: Do not just aim to do a lot of questions. Work intelligently: learn, practise, analyse your mistakes, then start again before sitting a full mock exam. That is how preparation actually becomes effective.

guide.endSubtitle: Five full mock exams and eight listening series, from A1 to C2, with detailed corrections, an estimated CEFR level and audio transcriptions.
guide.endNote: 370 original questions. No bank details required.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: What data TCF Simulator collects, why, how long it is kept, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.intro1: TCF Simulator is a platform for practising the TCF. This policy explains which personal data is processed, for which purposes, and what means you have to control it.
privacy.intro2: TCF Simulator is an independent service. It is not produced, endorsed or operated by France Éducation international, which remains the only body awarding the TCF.
privacy.dataBody: We only collect the data strictly required for the platform to work:
privacy.dataAccount: Your account details: email address, display name, hashed password and interface language.
privacy.dataAttempts: Your test attempts: selected answers, timing, obtained score and estimated CEFR level.
privacy.dataTechnical: Technical browsing data (IP address, browser type) kept for security and technical diagnostics.
privacy.dataNoSell: No data is sold, rented or transferred to third parties for advertising purposes.
privacy.useBody: Your data is used exclusively to provide the service:
privacy.useProvide: Create and secure your account, and let you resume an interrupted test.
privacy.useProgress: Compute your scores, your progress and your personal statistics.
privacy.useSecurity: Detect fraudulent activity and protect the availability of the service.
privacy.hostingBody: The database and the application infrastructure are hosted by a provider located in the European Union. Connection data travels over an encrypted link. Developer access to the database is limited to what is required for operations and is never used to build a profile of you.
privacy.retentionBody: Account data is kept for as long as the account is active. On request, or after a long period of inactivity, the account and its attempts are deleted. Security logs are kept for thirteen months at most.
privacy.rightsBody: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights, all free of charge:
privacy.rightsAccess: obtain a copy of the data concerning you
privacy.rightsErase: request deletion of your account and its content
privacy.rightsPortability: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
privacy.cookiesBody: A session cookie is set at login so you stay signed in. It is strictly necessary for the service: it is not used for audience measurement or advertising. No third-party advertising cookie is set.
privacy.childrenBody: The platform is intended for an adult audience. Users under sixteen must obtain a legal representative's approval before creating an account.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about your data, or to exercise any of the rights listed above, use the contact form shown on the home page. You will receive a response within one month at most.
